title: Floor Area Regulations in the North Subdistrict
previewText: Within the North Subdistrict, as shown on Map 1 in the Appendix to this Chapter, for all permitted uses, the floor area provisions of Article VI, Chapter 2 (Special Regulations Applying in the Waterfront Area) shall apply. However, in no event shall the maximum floor area ratio for any zoning lot exceed 4.6.
